caveats: 26 October fixture inventory increased from 66 at 03:03 TRT to 87 in the later read; this scan uses the later SELECT inventory, no fixtures silently discarded.
No source snapshots for this match-date cohort were found in research_archive.moneyway_snapshots, so public historical capture was used.
Only fully observed market selection sets at the selected checkpoint are eligible; partial market snapshots are flagged, never treated as complete.
T8 fallback was checked for each missing T6 complete market; no additional complete market qualified at T8.
Retention and V2 were checked against all available raw 1X2 ticks in their respective windows; this cannot prove that the upstream capture recorded every possible SmartXFlow observation.
Source SXF odds are market observations, not necessarily executable bookmaker prices.
SURPRISE is upset/non-loss risk; its quoted SXF odds are team win odds.
No match result, FT score, settlement or ROI was read for selection construction.
